title: RSVP with flankers - sentences with semantic and syntactic violations
description: This dataset contains EEG recordings from an RSVP-with-flankers reading paradigm examining sentence processing of semantic and syntactic violations. Participants viewed 180 sentences containing subject-verb agreement violations, semantic violations, combined violations, word-order violations, and correct control sentences, presented word-by-word with flanking words visible. The study was conducted at the NeuroCognition Laboratory to investigate neural correlates of language comprehension using event-related potentials.
methods_description: Participants sat in a darkened sound-attenuated room and viewed sentences on an LCD monitor at 152 cm viewing distance, presented via RSVP with flankers (three words shown simultaneously, each central word displayed for 400ms with no ISI, sliding rightward to reveal the next word). Stimuli comprised 180 sentences across five conditions: subject-verb agreement violations, semantic violations, combined violations, word-order violations, and correct controls (30 each except 60 controls). EEG was recorded while participants read the sentences and made behavioral responses via keyboard and verbal responses recorded with a headset.
